主要内容: BROADWAY FINANCIAL CORP \DE\ announced its intention to file a registration statement on Form S-4 with the SEC, which will include a joint proxy statement and prospectus related to a proposed business combination with CFBanc. The filing will contain important information about the transaction, and investors are urged to read the documents carefully. The Company and CFBanc plan to file other relevant documents with the SEC. Investors can access free copies of the documents through the SEC website or the Company’s website. Certain directors and executive officers of the Company and CFBanc may be deemed participants in the proxy solicitation. The Joint Proxy/Prospectus will provide details about the participants and their interests. The Company and CFBanc will provide the documents to stockholders once they are available. The filing includes forward-looking statements, which involve risks and uncertainties.
